run_export_weights_from_checkpoint: run the model weights exporter CLI to extract weights from a Lightning checkpoint file
run_extract_weights_with_model_name: run the exporter with a specific model name attribute to extract weights from a checkpoint
run_save_weights_to_path: run the exporter to extract and save model weights from a checkpoint to a specified output path
review_main_function: review the main function that parses CLI args and extracts model weights from a Lightning checkpoint
refactor_exporter_for_new_format: refactor the model weights exporter to support a different checkpoint format or output format
